On this page

Organization administrators use **Settings** \> **Organization** \> **AI Governance** to control reusable AI instructions and organization-level AI usage.

## Available controls [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/administering-koodisi/configuring-organization-settings/ai-governance/\#available-controls "Direct link to Available controls")

| Tab | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| **AI Skills** | Manage reusable skill definitions and their supporting files |
| **AI Requirements** | Define reusable requirements that guide generated work |
| **AI Usage** | Review usage analytics; visible only to authorized administrators and owners |
| **AI Settings** | Configure daily credit limits and the organization-wide AI kill switch |

## Governance practices [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/administering-koodisi/configuring-organization-settings/ai-governance/\#governance-practices "Direct link to Governance practices")

- Assign an owner and review date to every skill and requirement.
- Keep instructions specific, testable, and free of secrets or customer data.
- Review generated changes before accepting them into an application.
- Limit MCP tools to approved servers and least-privilege scopes.
- Monitor usage for unexpected growth, repeated failures, or abnormal tool calls.
- Use the kill switch when risk cannot be contained through narrower access controls.

The kill switch is an emergency control, not a substitute for identity, authorization, prompt review, data classification, or tool-level restrictions.

See the [Koodisi AI user guide](https://docs.koodisi.com/nxagent-user-guide/) for AI-assisted development and [AI integrations, tools, and authorization](https://docs.koodisi.com/api-manager/ai-integrations-tools-and-authorization/) for runtime boundaries.
